title: WSMath content
description: Every editable word, number and image on wsmath.com. One property per file in src/content/.

copyrightHolder.title: Copyright holder
copyrightHolder.description: The name on the © line in the footer, e.g. Winson Siu. Kept separate from the brand name because a rights notice names a legal person, not a trading name. docs/07-content-conflicts.md has this open with the owner.

tutorName.title: Tutor name
tutorName.description: Full name as it should appear everywhere, e.g. Winson Siu.

tutorNameZh.title: Tutor name (Chinese)
tutorNameZh.description: Chinese name or title, e.g. 數學軍師.

taglineEn.title: Tagline (English)
taglineEn.description: One line describing what you do, e.g. International Mathematics Exam Strategist.

taglineZh.title: Tagline (Chinese)
taglineZh.description: The same line in Chinese, e.g. 國際數學科考試軍師.

description.title: Short description
description.description: One sentence used in the footer and in search results, e.g. Structured learning, exam strategy, measurable progress.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: The square mark shown in the footer, e.g. /icon.png.

ogImage.title: Share image
ogImage.description: Shown when a link to the site is pasted into WhatsApp or a social post. 1200×630 works best.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Names and marks. Changing these changes them everywhere.

whatsappPhone.title: WhatsApp number
whatsappPhone.description: Digits only, including the country code and no + sign, e.g. 85269447214. Used to build every wa.me link on the site.

timezoneLabel.title: Time zone
timezoneLabel.description: Shown in the footer, e.g. Hong Kong / Global online.

centreAddress.title: Centre address
centreAddress.description: Where face-to-face lessons happen, e.g. Times Square, Causeway Bay. Also used by search engines.

socials.title: Social profiles
socials.description: Add, remove or reorder. Each one shows as an icon in the footer.

tutoringHours.title: 1-to-1 tutoring hours
tutoringHours.description: Digits only, e.g. 20000. The + and the comma are added automatically.

teachingSince.title: Teaching since
teachingSince.description: Year and month you started, as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2017-09. Years of experience is calculated from this, so it can never go stale.

oneToOneSince.title: 1-to-1 engagements since
oneToOneSince.description: Year the 1-to-1 practice started, e.g. 2018. Distinct from 'Teaching since' — the packages snapshot quotes this one. docs/07-content-conflicts.md §A2 has the two dates open with the owner; until they are reconciled both are editable here rather than typed into copy.

iaYearRange.title: Maths IA years
iaYearRange.description: The span those IA students cover, e.g. 2020–2025.

questionBankYears.title: Question bank years
questionBankYears.description: The span the past-paper bank covers, e.g. 2008–2025.

pastPapersIbdp.title: IBDP past-paper years
pastPapersIbdp.description: The span of past papers in the IBDP courses, e.g. 2008–2026. Shown on every IBDP course row.

pastPapersIal.title: International A-Level past-paper years
pastPapersIal.description: The span of past papers in the IAL course, e.g. 2014–2026.

pastPapersCambridgeIgcse.title: Cambridge IGCSE past-paper years
pastPapersCambridgeIgcse.description: The span of past papers in the 0607 and 0606 courses, e.g. 2014–2026.

pastPapersEdexcelIgcse.title: Edexcel International GCSE past-paper years
pastPapersEdexcelIgcse.description: The span of past papers in the 4MA1 course, e.g. 2018–2025.

stats.title: Headline numbers
stats.description: Edit once here. Every sentence on the site that mentions these numbers updates with it.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency code shown before every price.

locale.title: Number format
locale.description: Locale used to group digits, e.g. en-HK gives 19,800. Pinned so every visitor sees the same figure.

privateHourlyRate.title: 1-to-1 hourly rate
privateHourlyRate.description: Digits only, e.g. 1500. Will be parsed as a number.

coursePrice.title: Course price
coursePrice.description: Digits only, e.g. 16800. What most board courses cost — AASL, AISL, the IAL course, 0607 and 4MA1. The headline figure on the cards and the one the value comparison uses.

coursePriceHigher.title: Course price, higher tier
coursePriceHigher.description: Digits only, e.g. 19800. What the harder courses cost — AAHL, AIHL and 0606.

courseListPrice.title: Course list price
courseListPrice.description: Digits only, e.g. 60000. The undiscounted price, shown struck through above the real one. The saving and the discount percentage are calculated from it.

pricing.title: Prices
pricing.description: Every price on the page comes from here. The savings, the per-lesson rate and the comparison bars are all calculated from the figures here.

sessionMinutes.title: 1-to-1 lesson length (minutes)
sessionMinutes.description: Digits only, e.g. 90. Used to convert 1-to-1 lessons into hours.

courseSessionMinutes.title: Group lesson length (minutes)
courseSessionMinutes.description: Digits only, e.g. 50. How long one live group lesson runs. Used to turn lesson counts into teaching hours, so the 1-to-1 comparison compares like with like.

ibdpLessonCount.title: Lessons in an IBDP course
ibdpLessonCount.description: Digits only, e.g. 28. Applies to all four IBDP courses. The per-lesson rate and the value comparison use it.

ialLessonCount.title: Lessons in the International A-Level course

edexcelIgcseLessonCount.title: Lessons in the Edexcel International GCSE course
edexcelIgcseLessonCount.description: Digits only, e.g. 24. This is the 4MA1 course only — 0607 and 0606 are video courses with no live lessons.

ibdpBonusVideoHoursStandard.title: Bonus video hours, IBDP SL
ibdpBonusVideoHoursStandard.description: Digits only, e.g. 32. Teaching video given on top of the live lessons in AASL and AISL.

ibdpBonusVideoHoursAdvanced.title: Bonus video hours, IBDP HL
ibdpBonusVideoHoursAdvanced.description: Digits only, e.g. 64. Teaching video given on top of the live lessons in AAHL and AIHL.

videoHours0607.title: Length of the 0607 video course (hours)
videoHours0607.description: Digits only, e.g. 32. 0607 is a video course, so this is the whole product. The 0606 card also quotes it, because 0606 bundles these videos in.

videoHours0606.title: Length of the 0606 video course (hours)
videoHours0606.description: Digits only, e.g. 32. 0606's own teaching video, separate from the 0607 videos it bundles.

intensiveLessonCount.title: Lessons in the intensive block
intensiveLessonCount.description: Digits only, e.g. 8. Used to compute the block cost.

curricula.title: Curricula taught
curricula.description: One per line, e.g. IBDP, A-Level / IAL, IGCSE. Every sentence listing them is built from this.

programme.title: Programme shape
programme.description: Lesson counts and lengths. Every sentence on the site that quotes one is built from these.

platform.title: Lesson platform
platform.description: Where live lessons happen, e.g. Zoom.

items.title: Item
items.description: One piece of kit, e.g. iPad.

equipment.title: Recommended equipment
equipment.description: One item per line, e.g. iPad, Apple Pencil, GoodNotes. Joined with + wherever the kit is listed.

hlSixPlusRate.title: Math HL 6+ rate
hlSixPlusRate.description: As you want it written, e.g. 65%+.

slSixPlusRate.title: Math SL 6+ rate
slSixPlusRate.description: As you want it written, e.g. 65%+.

avgUplift.title: Average grade uplift
avgUplift.description: As you want it written, e.g. 2+.

improvedOneBand.title: Improved at least one band
improvedOneBand.description: As you want it written, e.g. 90%+ improved ≥1 band.

typicalTimeToGain.title: Typical time to first gain
typicalTimeToGain.description: As you want it written, e.g. Often within 8–12 weeks.

satisfaction.title: Satisfaction
satisfaction.description: As you want it written, e.g. Very high satisfaction.

topBandsLabel.title: Top bands
topBandsLabel.description: How the top outcomes read, e.g. 6–7 / A–A* outcomes.

outcomes.title: Outcome claims
outcomes.description: Marketing claims shown in the results snapshot. Keep them true — they are the strongest thing on the page.

siteUrl.title: Site address
siteUrl.description: The live address, e.g. https://wsmath.com. No trailing slash.

title.title: Page title
title.description: Shown in the browser tab and as the headline in search results.

description.title: Search description
description.description: One or two sentences shown under the title in search results.

label.title: Credit prefix
label.description: Text before the name, e.g. Built by.

name.title: Builder name
name.description: Who built the site, e.g. XiniDev.

githubUrl.title: Builder GitHub
githubUrl.description: Optional. Second link on the builder credit, e.g. a GitHub profile.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: What it is built with, shown after the name, e.g. Next.js + Tailwind.

navSections.title: Navigation
navSections.description: The links in the top bar, in order. Each one jumps to a section; the 01/02/03 numbering follows the order automatically.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Business facts referenced across the whole site. Change a number here and every sentence that mentions it changes with it.

src.title: Image path
src.description: Path to the file in /public, e.g. /avatars/alice-gao-2022.webp.

alt.title: Alt text
alt.description: Describe what the image shows, for screen readers and for when the image fails to load. Every image needs its own — never reuse one description for two photos.

width.title: Intrinsic width (px)
width.description: The file's real pixel width. Reserves space so the page does not jump while loading.

MediaRef.title: Image
MediaRef.description: An image, its alt text and its intrinsic size.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Which network this link points at. Drives the icon.

url.title: Profile URL
url.description: Full link to the profile or page, including https://.

id.title: Section anchor
id.description: The id of the section this links to, e.g. about. Must match a section on the page.

label.title: Menu label
label.description: What the navigation shows, e.g. About. The 01/02/03 number is added automatically.

sectionMarks.title: Menu links
sectionMarks.description: The top-bar links, in order. Each points at a section of the page.

brandLabel.title: Brand label
brandLabel.description: The small caps wordmark beside the logo, e.g. WSMath.

menuLabel.title: Menu description
menuLabel.description: Read out by screen readers for the whole bar, e.g. Primary.

ctaLabel.title: Button label
ctaLabel.description: The brass button in the top bar, e.g. Get in touch.

skipLabel.title: Skip link
skipLabel.description: The keyboard skip link at the very top, e.g. Skip to content.

eyebrow.title: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: The line above the name, e.g. {{brand.taglineEn}}.

inscription.title: Chinese inscription
inscription.description: The vertical Chinese line beside the name, e.g. {{brand.taglineZh}}.

portrait.title: Portrait
portrait.description: Path to the hero image in /public, e.g. /hero.webp. Loaded first, so keep the file small.

proof.title: Proof lines
proof.description: The credential lines under the headline number. Split each line where the bold starts and stops.

scope.title: Scope line
scope.description: The small caps curricula line, e.g. {{programme.curriculaDots}}.

id.title: ID
id.description: Permanent identifier. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. james-chow-2024. Never change it once set — other records point at it.

text.title: Fact
text.description: One short fact line, e.g. 93 result records · 30 schools.

facts.title: Fact lines
facts.description: The short fact lines above the WhatsApp button.

ctaLabel.title: Button label
ctaLabel.description: The hero WhatsApp button, e.g. Get in touch.

items.title: Points
items.description: One ruled line each on the paper sheet.

items.title: Points
items.description: One ruled line each on the paper sheet.

figure.title: Photograph
figure.description: The teaching photograph on the raised plate.

label.title: Label
label.description: The small caps label, e.g. Who I teach.

ageLead.title: Age range
ageLead.description: The large serif part, e.g. Ages 15–18.

ageRest.title: Beside the ages
ageRest.description: The rest of the line, e.g. students worldwide.

rows.title: Programme rows
rows.description: Label on the left, course codes on the right, e.g. IBDP Math → AAHL, AASL, AIHL, AISL.

chip.title: Setup chip
chip.description: The kit line in the rounded chip, e.g. Best setup: {{setup.equipmentList}}.

items.title: Journeys
items.description: The seven short journeys shown as pills under the grid. These restate records from the results section — keep them in step or the two will disagree.

groupMarkLabel.title: Group-course marker
groupMarkLabel.description: The sentence the diamond beside a course name stands for, e.g. Also sold as a scheduled group course. Read out by screen readers on every marked row, and printed once as the legend under the trays.

displayCodes.title: Display codes
displayCodes.description: Short codes for courses that have none in the Course groups document (the IBDP courses and IBMYP). Courses with a real exam-board code show that code automatically.

ariaLabel.title: Landmark name
ariaLabel.description: Never shown. Names the band for screen readers moving between landmarks, e.g. Availability.

title.title: Heading
title.description: The big line in the carmine band.

waLabel.title: Small label
waLabel.description: The small caps label above the button, e.g. WhatsApp.

title.title: Heading
title.description: e.g. Choose the path that fits your goal.

id.title: ID
id.description: Permanent identifier. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. james-chow-2024. Never change it once set — other records point at it.

chips.title: Label chips
chips.description: The debossed label chips under the heading.

title.title: Ledger heading
title.description: The small caps line above the ledger, e.g. IBDP Mathematics group course.

rows.title: Ledger rows
rows.description: The valuation ledger, e.g. Was → {{money pricing.courseListPrice}}.

snapList.title: Snapshot rows
snapList.description: The label/value rows under the headline figure.

cells.title: Comparison cells
cells.description: The two wells: standard 1-to-1 cost vs the group course investment.

rateLabel.title: Rate label
rateLabel.description: The small caps label before the private price, e.g. Typical rate.

live.title: Live badge
live.description: The word on a scheduled course's badge, e.g. Live.

video.title: Video badge
video.description: The word on a self-paced course's badge, e.g. Video.

iaFootTag.title: IA block foot tag
iaFootTag.description: The small caps line in the IA course's foot.

ctaLabel.title: Button label
ctaLabel.description: The label on the package WhatsApp buttons, e.g. Get in touch.

label.title: Panel label
label.description: The floating panel's title, e.g. Your plan.

pickShow.title: Pick label
pickShow.description: The button before a plan is chosen, e.g. Show in your plan.

pickActive.title: Picked label
pickActive.description: The button once the plan is chosen, e.g. In your plan.

ctaLabel.title: Panel button label
ctaLabel.description: The WhatsApp button in the floating panel, e.g. Get in touch.

defaultPackageId.title: Preselected plan
defaultPackageId.description: The ID of the package the floating panel starts on, e.g. ibdp. It must be a package that has a price.

label.title: Headline label
label.description: e.g. average grade uplift (From PG/mock to final).

snapList.title: Snapshot rows
snapList.description: The label/value wells under the heading.

sub.title: First line
sub.description: e.g. How students move from school predictions to final exam results.

scaleRight.title: Published line
scaleRight.description: e.g. {{content.publishedRecordCount}} of them are published individually below.

tabsLabel.title: Tab strip description
tabsLabel.description: Read out before the group tabs, e.g. Result groups.

tabsCountLabel.title: Tab count prefix
tabsCountLabel.description: Printed before each tab's record count, e.g. n = . Keep the trailing space.

readIdle.title: Read-out prompt
readIdle.description: e.g. Hover a ribbon to read its record.

drawnTemplate.title: Read-out summary
drawnTemplate.description: Shown when nothing is hovered. Write {group} for the group name, {n} for its size and {k} for the drawn count, e.g. {group} · n = {n} · {k} published records drawn.

caption.title: Table caption
caption.description: Describes the table for screen readers, e.g. Grade improvements — number of published records in each grade-jump band, by final grade, for the selected course group.

id.title: ID
id.description: Permanent identifier. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. james-chow-2024. Never change it once set — other records point at it.

binLabels.title: Column headings
binLabels.description: Exactly four: 0–1, 2, 3 and 4+ grade improvements, in that order.

readoutIdle.title: Read-out prompt
readoutIdle.description: Shown before any cell is chosen.

readoutIdleStream.title: Read-out prompt — stream sentence
readoutIdleStream.description: The second half of the prompt, printed only where the rising stream is on screen. Phones do not draw the stream, so anything referring to it belongs here and not above.

note.title: Helper note
note.description: The small line under the table, e.g. 👆 Hover on each cell to see the students.

legend.title: Summary counts
legend.description: Each row counts something across the published records. The number and percentage are calculated, never typed.

legendScope.title: Summary scope
legendScope.description: The line under the counts, e.g. Over the {{content.publishedRecordCount}} published records.

id.title: ID
id.description: Permanent identifier. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. james-chow-2024. Never change it once set — other records point at it.

chips.title: Label chips
chips.description: The debossed label chips under the summary counts.

title.description: e.g. Start your IBDP / A-Level / IGCSE coaching.

id.description: Permanent identifier. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. james-chow-2024. Never change it once set — other records point at it.

rows.title: Points
rows.description: Shown as short lines above the WhatsApp button.

prov.title: Note
prov.description: Tiny note under the points (e.g. response time / what to send).

trio.title: Prompt trio
trio.description: The small caps prompt beside the button, e.g. (name?) · (school?) · (year?).

art.description: The image in the small well beside the call to action.

title.title: Heading
title.description: e.g. What my students and parents say.

provider.title: Video host
provider.description: Where the video lives. Paste the normal share link below — the embed link is worked out for you.

url.title: Video link
url.description: Paste the share link exactly as the host gives it.

stamp.title: Corner stamp
stamp.description: The small caps line under the player, e.g. Video · replays available.

heading.title: Heading beside the video
heading.description: e.g. Real students talking about their WSMath journey.

clips.title: Clips
clips.description: The students in the video, in order.

label.title: Label
label.description: The line above the drifting row, e.g. Twelve more, in four written languages.

items.title: Testimonial
items.description: The ID of a testimonial from the Testimonials document.

sheetIds.title: Sheets shown
sheetIds.description: Which testimonials drift through the row, in order. Pick from the carousel testimonials — the quotes themselves live in the Testimonials document.

universityShortNames.title: University short names
universityShortNames.description: Universities shortened on the small sheets. Any university not listed here is shown in full.

socialsLabel.title: Social links description
socialsLabel.description: Read out before the icons, e.g. Social.

columns.title: Link columns
columns.description: The columns of links in the footer.

body.title: Body
body.description: Short paragraph under the heading. Keep it concise and action-oriented.

meta.title: Practical details
meta.description: The lines under the WhatsApp button.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: Small note after the rights line. Keep it short and professional.

modalTitle.title: Title
modalTitle.description: Shown at the top of the privacy panel, e.g. Privacy Policy.

lastUpdated.title: Last updated
lastUpdated.description: The date the policy last changed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

Pages.title: Page copy
Pages.description: The wording of each section. Numbers, prices and names come from Settings — write {{token.path}} rather than typing them again.

label.title: Menu label

fullSizeLabel.description: Shown on the small plate in the corner of the page, e.g. Open at full size.

eyebrow.description: Optional small line above the heading.

kind.description: Anchor: jumps to a section on this page. Modal: opens the privacy policy. WhatsApp: starts a chat. External: opens another site.

href.title: Destination
href.description: For an anchor, the section id with a hash, e.g. #packages. For an external link, the full address. Leave blank for modal and WhatsApp.

body.title: Body
body.description: The paragraph. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.

id.title: Scale ID
id.description: Permanent identifier, e.g. ibdp, alevel, igcse. Programmes point at it.

name.title: Scale name
name.description: What this scale is called, e.g. IBDP 1–7.

railOffset.title: Rail offset
railOffset.description: How many empty rungs sit below this scale on the shared 9-rung rail. Nine minus the number of bands, so the top grade of every scale lines up: IBDP and A-Level use 2, IGCSE uses 0.

bands.title: Grades
bands.description: Lowest grade first, highest last. Add, remove or reorder — the rail redraws itself.

value.title: Recorded grade
value.description: Exactly as it is written on the record, e.g. 7, A*, or B(7). Student results are matched against this, letter for letter.

label.title: Short label
label.description: How it prints on the rail, e.g. B. Usually the grade without the bracketed number.

order.title: Rung
order.description: Position on the scale, counting up from the lowest grade at 0. One rung = one grade step.

id.title: Programme ID
id.description: Permanent identifier, e.g. ibdp-hl. Student records point at it.

family.title: Curriculum
family.description: Which curriculum this programme belongs to.

label.title: Programme name
